fields.description: Bay Villas brings five distinct home collections to Island B at Dubai Islands. The homes range from three-bedroom family layouts to six-bedroom beachfront residences. Landscaped parks, shared leisure spaces and the shoreline give the community its coastal setting; each collection has its own layout and specification.
amenities: Children's play areas and tot lots

research.community: Bay Villas · Island B · Dubai Islands
overview: The developer identifies 636 homes across townhouses, semi-detached, garden, waterfront and beachfront villas. The waterfront and beachfront collections are distinct: a waterfront address does not establish that every property has direct beach frontage.

The reviewed townhouse drawings show several block and layout codes. Pool and landscape drawings are illustrative, and the plan disclaimer says these are not provided by the developer. Included works must be checked against the chosen unit specification.
research.locationNote: Island B, Dubai Islands, is confirmed by the developer. Dubai Islands is not yet an exact location entry in the local taxonomy; no nearby area or invented coordinates have been substituted.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains AED 4 million as its historical project guide while its live headline shows AED 5 million for the lowest advertised listing and marks developer stock sold out. These have different bases. AED 4 million is not a current developer offer or evidence of available stock.
research.paymentNote: Page 1 of the reviewed branded sheet totals 100%: 15% booking, 65% dated instalments and 20% handover. Page 2 instead prints 10% for December 2025, producing a 95% total. The schedule below transcribes page 1, not a correction to page 2. Property Finder separately publishes 20/ 60/ 20. Current terms require a unit-specific signed schedule.
research.handoverNote: The branded sheet gives estimated handover Q2 2027; Property Finder gives June 2027. No guarantee or unit-specific revised contractual date was established.
unresolved: No current developer inventory, unit quotation or applicable resale payment balance verified.
